repeaters.label: Items: What makes Prospects Hive differ
shells:
What makes Prospects Hive different from a traditional lead generation agency?

Other agencies focus on running outbound campaigns and generating leads. We build the GTM system behind them, combining market research, buyer intelligence, targeted outreach and revenue workflows so your pipeline becomes predictable.

What does a B2B GTM agency do?

It works out who you should sell to and what to say, then builds the data, outreach, CRM and automation that turn that plan into qualified sales conversations.

Do you only provide outbound services?

Outbound is our core, but we also cover GTM strategy, ABM, B2B content marketing, CRM and revenue operations, and AI workflow automation, all connected into one system.

How do you identify the right target accounts and buyers?

[Answer: the ICP research, buying signals and filters you use]

Can you help improve our existing outbound campaigns?

[Answer: how you audit and improve existing campaigns]

How do you measure and optimise campaign performance?

We track every stage, from replies to meetings to closed deals, then adjust targeting, messaging and workflows based on what the numbers show.
